_description: Boards that must not be recommended, renamed boards, platforms with a declared market scope, and boards now owned by another board (ownership: the name carries the owner note, and owner and owned board count as one group when budget is split). Read by publisher_filter.py and applied on every plan surface (workbook, deck, Nova tools). Every entry carries a source and an as_of date; a claim without a source does not belong here.

events.event: Joblift GmbH filed for preliminary insolvency proceedings
Adzuna bought Joblift's assets (brand, platform, customer contacts) in an asset deal without the company's debts

ownership.decision: joblift.de still runs as its own brand in Germany, so it stays fundable there; every surface naming it carries the note, and the local-relevance score treats Joblift and Adzuna as one group so a plan never funds both as independent boards
